setting.dshPath.description: Absolute path to the DSH executable on the machine where the extension runs. In a Remote window, set this under Remote Settings. A path unavailable on that host is ignored and DSH is discovered there automatically. For a source checkout, point to the built apps/cli/lib/bin.js file. Takes effect the next time DSH starts.
setting.themeSync.description: Follow the VS Code color theme into the embedded DSH UI.
setting.completionSound.description: Play sounds for DSH session events: task finished, task started, and when the harness asks for your input.
setting.frameFontScale.description: Zoom for the embedded DSH UI content (1 = default size). Lower values make the DSH interface more compact.
